scope: Reassessment of every previously good or purgatory sample from the 40-file Hopper bad batch, using a compromised-endpoint investigation perspective.
supersedes: ../hopper-bad-evidence-20261023/review.json for these 25 SHA-256 values only; prior 15 bad files were outside this follow-up scope.
assessment_policy: Use the established hostile behavior to classify hostile artifacts without demanding proof of every later action. Caller-requested job execution alone does not disqualify a wheel from benign training; the 14 job projects are retained in purgatory because PyPI explicitly quarantines them. Endpoint judgments describe only actual emitted cleave findings, with manual analysis and external registry status kept explicitly separate.
methods: Static source review without importing wheel/npm modules or executing lifecycle hooks.
Native PE/Mach-O disassembly, Go pclntab/call-graph recovery, authenticated configuration decryption and bounded isolated Unicorn CPU emulation.
Every emulated Windows/macOS API is a mock. No specimen-requested host process, filesystem, driver, certificate or network operation was forwarded; CPU execution is not full OS behavior.
PyPI metadata/wheel downloads were analyst-initiated provenance checks. Recovered specimen endpoints were not contacted.
trait_changes: Add two suspicious caller-side Intel IOCTL request-block traits: actual packet selector/length and call pattern, beyond a bare vulnerable-driver identity.
Add a hostile install-triggered random disposable npm publication composite and a neutral manifest-template atom; do not label it credential theft.
Keep the old remote-Python co-occurrence hostile rule retired. Fourteen contextual purgatory labels do not justify inflating generic downloader primitives.
Add native word-mixed buffer XOR, repeated conditional table dispatch and probable indirect secure-request argument-block traits.
Extend the canonical x64 RWX argument trait to the reserve/commit indirect-register call block; add adjacent loader-list insertion and Defender-style export observations.
Add a hostile unsigned Defender-export facade / RWX / loader-list / TLS-obfuscation composite.
Add Go pclntab-backed relative call-site traits for script-command construction, persistence registry writing, ROOT certificate request logic and anti-analysis dispatch.
remaining_detection_gaps: No automatic decoder or child extractor was added for the custom native encrypted beacon strings or rebrrgb.dll mapped payload. Their network destination, POST body and stage relationship remain manual evidence, excluded from automatic endpoint judgments.
Zenconnekt encrypted configuration decryption remains analyst-assisted. New traits bind pclntab function metadata to actual child-command, registry, ROOT-request and anti-analysis call sites.

Mach-O/XL protected behavior and installer decryption remain incomplete. Their judgments describe detected obfuscation, dynamic-dispatch references and encrypted installer structure, without inferring hidden behavior.
